sentences.text:
Respondent/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr.Dilip Kumar, Adv.
 For the Respondent/s : Mrs. Anita Kumari Singh, App

= =====================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SHAILENDRA SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 15-12-2023 1. Heard learned counsel for the Appellant and learned APP for the State.

2. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC and after conviction, the convicting trial Court granted her the relief of Provisional Bail and within the period of Provisional Bail she filed this appeal and thereafter, the said privilege of Provisional Bail was extended by this Court vide order 12.04.2023, accordingly, a prayer is made to confirm the said privilege of Provisional Bail.

3. The Provisional Bail granted by the Trial Court to the appellant is hereby confirmed in connection with ST. Case No. 379/2015 arising out of Pirpainti P.S. Case No. 214 of 2009 on the same bail bond taken by the trial Court and the Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.1073 of 2023(3) dt.15-12-2023 appellant shall be deemed to be on bail during the pendency of this appeal.
4. The sentence of fine shall remain stayed during the pedency of this appeal.

5. Let the appeal be listed under the heading "For Hearing" in due course.
(Shailendra Singh, J) Maynaz/-
